route: MCP hole and edit_hole with a thread -> document rebuild -> native hole of the tap drill -> thread item in pmi_list -> viewport and checked STEP export
supported_limits: ISO metric coarse and fine threads, M1.6 to M64, on a hole's main wall; a cosmetic thread, no modelled teeth; size, pitch and depth edits, undo/redo, a drill that does not take the thread refuses without changing the part, a later cut on top, save and fresh-process reopen. Pattern and mirror copies of a tapped hole are not threaded.
evidence: result.json, protocol.json, commands/NNNN/{command.json,kernel.json,measurement.json,viewport.png,view.svg}; saved part; checked STEP and independent volume and point oracle
